input.submitFailed: The message could not finish sending. Uncommitted text and images have been kept; check the thread before retrying.
input.memoryDrafts: Unsent chat drafts are kept only in this tab’s memory, including hidden threads. Send or discard them and wait for pending sends before switching workspaces; closing or reloading can lose them.
input.discardAllDraftsConfirm: Discard unsent text and images from every chat thread in this workspace and cancel pending image reads? Saved messages will not be changed. A send already in progress must still finish and may save its message. This cannot be undone.

draftError.length: A draft can contain at most 200,000 characters. The previous draft has been kept; shorten or split the message.
draftError.total: Unsent chat drafts can contain at most 1,000,000 characters in total. Send or discard other drafts first; the previous draft has been kept.

imageError.busy: Wait for the current image batch to finish. Your draft has been kept.
imageError.count: Attach at most 4 images per message. Your draft and earlier images have been kept.
imageError.type: Choose PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP images. Your draft and earlier images have been kept.
imageError.size: Each image must be 5 MiB or smaller. Your draft and earlier images have been kept.
imageError.total: Images must total 10 MiB or less per message. Your draft and earlier images have been kept.
imageError.global: Unsent chat drafts can hold at most 16 images and 20 MiB of image data in total, including reads in progress. Send or discard other drafts first; earlier images have been kept.
imageError.read: An image could not be read. The new batch was not attached; your draft and earlier images have been kept. Try selecting it again.
